⟦p004⟧Marriages thus contracted before the lawful age ordained by nature {a} cannot be pleasing to God, & the issue of them is most often wretched {b}.

A second paragraph on the same page runs on to the wo⟦p005⟧man of the next, where the annotation ends {a}.

## Notes
- {a} (p004): **Digest 23.2 (*De ritu nuptiarum*), l. *Minorem*** — L. minorem D. de rit. nup. [On the age of consent.]
- {b} (p004): **Aristotle, *History of Animals* 5.10** — Ariſtote au v. de la nature des animaux x. c. v.
- {a} (p005): **Macrobius, *On the Dream of Scipio* 1.6** — Macrobe au ſonge de Scipion c. vi. [On the number seven.]
- {c} (p005): **Pliny, *Natural History* 7.3** — Pline au vij liure de la naturelle hiſtoire. c. iij.
